_about: Public-domain James M. Gray (James Martin Gray, 1851-1935, Reformed Episcopal, President of Moody Bible Institute) for the Word Hoard, held to printings dated before 1930: the Christian Workers' Commentary (1915) from CCEL, How to Master the English Bible (1907) from Project Gutenberg, and 16 more from Internet Archive scans, 1899-1924, among them The Bulwarks of the Faith, Synthetic Bible Studies (1900 and the 1906 revision), Prophecy and the Lord's Return and A Text-Book on Prophecy. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 22 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
